import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.readline
    output = sys.stdout.write
    
    n = int(input().strip())
    bad = 1
    mod = 1000000007
    for j in range(n - 1):
        bad *= 2
        bad %= mod
    prod = 1
    for j in range(1, n + 1):
        prod *= j
        prod %= mod
    result = (prod - bad) % mod
    output(str(result) + '\n')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
